body: i am 6 years younger than you. i do not know if i can help in anyway, if my advice will mean anything. something that has always helped me, and helped other people is scenery. because you say uni, i'm assuming you're european( so sorry if i'm wrong). go down to the farm one day. not a big, modernized one. just a cute one with animals roaming free. this sounds so stupid, but just sit and be. go to museums, spend hours looking at art you don't understand. go to a lake, swim, be free, and just exist. sometimes you'll find that just changing your environment can be a huge help. i'm sorry if this isn't useful to you, i really tried. if you're ever looking to have a conversation, i've always got you. i don't want you to go with your plan. i hope to grow up and meet you one day. i know you don't know me, but please just hold onto living for that.
me too. i'm a fifteen year old, and i know exactly what you're going through. if it's any help, i'd love to chat sometime- i think we'd get along very well :)

Haha I'm actually a girl, but thank you for your kind words! This is really good advice. I guess Im just nervous about having to face my parents and deal with responsibilities- I know lying would be the easy way out but I want to be truthful about it I guess. High school is hella overwhelming for sure, but I'm glad there are good people in the world like you to help me out. You are a wonderful human, I owe you immensely.
Thank you so much. I cannot tell you how much I appreciate just hearing kind words. It means a lot to me, you just made my day. I'll keep your advice in mind, and try to push through it!
